name: Remove system.schema key/value Form
description: Admin form UI to remove orphaned system.schema key/value entries; the browser equivalent of rmkv's Drush commands.
project_description:
Module {uninstalled_module_machine_name} has an entry in the system.schema key/value storage, but is missing from your site. More information about this error. 

 Have you ever encountered such a warning?

 We have developed a module "rmkv" for developers to eliminate this warning.

 This case is rare but time-consuming, so use this module.

 Available drush commands:

 
 drush rmkv:check 

Check if the specified machine name can be removed from the system.schema key/value storage. 
 drush rmkv 

Remove the specified machine name from the system.schema key/value storage. 
 
 * Just in case, Must need to backup database before running "rmkv".

* v2.0.0 and later is Rmkv form have been submoduled. ( rmkv_form )
